title: Facilities Manager
description:
Facility Manager

Company: Phoenix Business Advisory

Department: Administration \& Operations

Location: Ahmedabad

Employment Type: Full\-Time

Experience: 3–6 Years

Reports To: HR Manager

About Phoenix Business Advisory

Phoenix Business Advisory is a business advisory firm specializing in business immigration and related advisory services. We are committed to maintaining a professional, efficient, and well\-managed workplace that supports our employees and business operations.

Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive and experienced Facility Manager to oversee the day\-to\-day management, maintenance, safety, and smooth functioning of our office facilities.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for maintaining a safe, clean, comfortable, and well\-organized workplace while managing vendors, office infrastructure, housekeeping, supplies, maintenance activities, facility expenses, and administrative requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Facility \& Office Management

\- Manage the day\-to\-day operations and upkeep of the office premises.

\- Ensure the workplace is clean, organized, safe, and well\-maintained.

\- Monitor office infrastructure, furniture, fixtures, electrical systems, HVAC/AC, plumbing, and other facilities.

\- Conduct regular facility inspections and ensure timely resolution of issues.

\- Proactively identify and address potential facility\-related concerns.

Vendor \& Service Provider Management

\- Coordinate with housekeeping, security, maintenance, pest control, electrical, plumbing, and other service providers.

\- Manage vendor relationships and ensure services meet required standards.

\- Obtain quotations and coordinate approvals for facility\-related purchases and services.

\- Track vendor bills, contracts, renewals, and service schedules.

\- Escalate and resolve vendor\-related issues in a timely manner.

Office Administration

\- Manage office supplies, stationery, pantry requirements, and administrative consumables.

\- Monitor inventory and coordinate timely procurement.

\- Maintain records of office assets, equipment, and facility materials.

\- Coordinate seating arrangements and workspace requirements.

\- Support office events, meetings, employee activities, and other administrative requirements.

Safety \& Security

\- Ensure workplace safety and security standards are maintained.

\- Coordinate with security personnel and manage office access and visitor requirements.

\- Ensure fire safety equipment and emergency systems are regularly inspected and maintained.

\- Handle emergency repairs and safety\-related concerns promptly.

\- Maintain relevant safety and facility documentation.

Maintenance \& Infrastructure

\- Plan and coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance.

\- Coordinate servicing and repairs related to electrical, HVAC/AC, plumbing, internet/network infrastructure, and office equipment.

\- Maintain records of maintenance activities and service schedules.

\- Minimize operational disruptions through proactive maintenance.

Budget \& Cost Management

\- Monitor facility and administrative expenses.

\- Maintain records of vendor payments and facility\-related expenditures.

\- Support budgeting and cost\-control initiatives.

\- Identify opportunities to optimize facility costs without compromising service quality.

Employee Support

\- Address employee concerns related to workplace facilities and infrastructure.

\- Ensure employees have a comfortable and functional working environment.

\- Coordinate with HR and Operations on facility\-related requirements.

\- Respond promptly to facility requests and ensure proper closure.

Compliance \& Documentation

\- Maintain records related to vendors, contracts, assets, maintenance, and facility operations.

\- Track required licenses, certificates, inspections, and renewals.

\- Support management and HR during audits and facility\-related compliance requirements.

Required Qualifications \& Skills

\- Bachelor's degree in Facility Management, Business Administration, Operations, or a related field.

\- 3–6 years of experience in facility management, office administration, workplace operations, or a similar role.

\- Strong vendor management and negotiation skills.

\- Good understanding of office infrastructure and maintenance.

\- Strong organizational, coordination, and multitasking abilities.

\- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

\- Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.

\- Ability to handle emergencies and operational issues effectively.

\- Proficiency in MS Office and Google Workspace.

\- Ability to coordinate effectively with internal teams and external service providers.

Preferred Skills

\- Experience managing corporate offices.

\- Experience handling multiple vendors and service providers.

\- Knowledge of workplace health, safety, and security practices.

\- Basic understanding of electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and general building maintenance.

\- Ability to work independently and take ownership of facility operations.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

\- Timely resolution of facility and maintenance issues.

\- Office cleanliness and workplace standards.

\- Vendor performance and service quality.

\- Effective facility cost management.

\- Timely completion of preventive maintenance.

\- Availability of office supplies and functional infrastructure.

\- Employee satisfaction with workplace facilities.

\- Timely completion of safety and compliance requirements.

What We Offer

\- Professional and growth\-oriented work environment.

\- Opportunity to work closely with management and cross\-functional teams.

\- Exposure to workplace administration and business operations.

\- Professional growth and development opportunities..

Pay: ₹16,259\.99 \- ₹31,974\.31 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

description:

title: Operations Manager
description:
Job Description:

Job Description:

**Company:** Vendiman  
**Industry:** Retail / Vending Machine Operations  
**Job Location:** Ahmedabad  
**Experience:** Minimum 2 Years  
**Department:** Operations

About the Role

Vendiman is looking for an **Assistant Manager – Operations** to manage and coordinate day\-to\-day vending machine operations across assigned locations. The role will focus on ensuring smooth operations, machine uptime, inventory availability, field\-team coordination, and achievement of operational and business targets.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage **day\-to\-day operations of vending machines** across assigned locations.
* Ensure machines are operational, adequately stocked, and maintained as per company standards.
* Monitor **machine\-wise and location\-wise sales, performance, uptime, and operational issues**.
* Coordinate with field teams, technicians, warehouse, sales, and other internal teams for smooth operations.
* Plan and monitor **refilling, replenishment, servicing, and preventive maintenance** activities.
* Track machine breakdowns, downtime, complaints, and ensure timely resolution within defined TAT.
* Monitor inventory and stock movement to ensure **product availability at vending machines**.
* Maintain operational reports and review performance against defined targets.
* Identify operational gaps and implement corrective actions to improve efficiency and machine performance.
* Conduct regular checks/audits of vending machines and ensure adherence to company processes.
* Handle escalations from clients, locations, and internal stakeholders related to vending machine operations.
* Support onboarding and operational setup of **new vending machine locations**.
* Coordinate with vendors and service partners wherever required.
* Prepare and share **daily, weekly, and monthly operational updates** with management.
* Ensure compliance with company SOPs, safety standards, and operational guidelines.
* Train and guide field/operations team members to ensure effective execution.
* Support management in achieving **sales, availability, uptime, and operational efficiency targets**.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Minimum **2 years of experience** in Operations, preferably in **Retail, Vending Machines, FMCG, QSR, Logistics, or a similar industry**.
* Good understanding of **field operations and team coordination**.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel / Google Sheets** and operational reporting.
* Ability to monitor and manage multiple locations simultaneously.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Good organizational and time\-management abilities.
* Willingness to travel within the assigned city/locations as required.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced and target\-oriented environment.

Key Performance Areas (KPIs)

* Vending machine **uptime and availability**
* Machine\-wise and location\-wise **sales performance**
* Timely refilling and replenishment
* Breakdown and complaint **resolution TAT**
* Inventory availability and accuracy
* Field\-team productivity
* Client/location satisfaction
* Compliance with operational SOPs
* Reduction of operational losses and inefficiencies

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be **hands\-on, proactive, and result\-oriented**, with strong field\-operations and team\-coordination skills. The candidate should be comfortable managing multiple vending machine locations and solving operational issues on the ground.

**Job Locations: Ahmedabad\| Experience: 2\+ Years \| Industry: Retail / Vending Machine Operations**

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Operations Manager
description:
**SENIOR OPERATIONS MANAGER**

**The Adbook India Private Limited**  
**Location:** Ahmedabad / Gandhinagar, Gujarat  
**Position:** Senior Operations Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

About The Adbook

The Adbook India Private Limited is a growing Digital Out\-of\-Home (DOOH) advertising company building a strong network of digital screens across Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar and other key markets.

We are looking for an experienced and highly organised Senior Operations Manager to take ownership of day\-to\-day operations, screen network performance, team coordination, client execution and business expansion.

Key Responsibilities

**Operations \& Network Management**

* Manage day\-to\-day operations of The Adbook's digital screen network.
* Ensure all screens are operational, connected and displaying scheduled campaigns correctly.
* Monitor CMS, screen uptime, content scheduling and technical issues.
* Coordinate installation, maintenance, relocation and replacement of digital screens.
* Develop systems and SOPs to improve operational efficiency.

**Team Management**

* Lead and coordinate operations, CMS, technical and field teams.
* Allocate responsibilities, monitor performance and ensure timely completion of tasks.
* Coordinate with sales, marketing and management teams.
* Train and develop operations staff.

**Client \& Campaign Execution**

* Ensure advertising campaigns are implemented accurately and on schedule.
* Coordinate with clients and agencies regarding campaign requirements.
* Monitor campaign delivery and resolve operational issues quickly.
* Maintain campaign records and operational reports.

**Business Expansion**

* Support expansion of The Adbook's screen network across Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar and new markets.
* Coordinate new\-site surveys, permissions, installation and commissioning.
* Work with management to identify operational requirements for new locations.
* Build relationships with building owners, facility managers, vendors and service providers.

**Vendor \& Cost Management**

* Manage vendors, technicians, installers and service providers.
* Negotiate operational costs and service agreements.
* Maintain inventory of screens, media players, networking equipment and spare parts.
* Implement cost\-control measures without compromising service quality.

**Reporting \& Process Improvement**

* Prepare regular operational and performance reports for management.
* Track screen uptime, maintenance, campaign execution and operational KPIs.
* Identify recurring problems and implement permanent solutions.
* Establish scalable processes as the company expands.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who has:

* 5\+ years of experience in operations, project management, business operations, OOH/DOOH, advertising, retail technology, networking or a related industry.
* Strong leadership and team\-management skills.
* Excellent coordination and communication abilities.
* Experience managing multiple projects/sites simultaneously.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to work with vendors, clients and internal teams.
* Good understanding of technology, networking, digital screens or CMS will be an advantage.
* Strong knowledge of Excel, reporting and operational MIS.
* A hands\-on approach with the ability to work in a fast\-growing environment.

What We Offer

* Senior management\-level responsibility in a growing DOOH company.
* Opportunity to help build and scale a digital advertising network.
* Direct exposure to business expansion and strategic operations.
* Performance\-based growth opportunities.
* Dynamic and entrepreneurial work environment.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is not just an administrator. We are looking for someone who can take ownership, build systems, manage people, solve problems and make operations scalable as The Adbook expands.

**If you are ready to take ownership of operations and be part of the next phase of The Adbook's growth, we would like to hear from you.**

Pay: ₹637,176\.48 \- ₹1,969,099\.86 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Gift City Branch - Market Operations Lead, Vice President
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Join JPMorganChase's India GIFT City buildout and lead a front\-line operations team at the center of trade lifecycle delivery. You will manage complex post\-trade processes across multiple markets products, strengthen controls, and drive automation and process improvements. This is a high\-visibility role for an experienced operations leader who can deliver results under pressure, develop talent, and partner effectively across trading, technology, risk, and compliance.  

  

As a Vice President Market Operations based in the GIFT City branch (Ahmedabad), you will lead a highly visible operations function responsible for end\-to\-end post‑trade delivery. You will own service delivery, controls, and regulatory compliance across products including foreign exchange, rates derivatives, options, fixed income, and money markets. Reporting to the India Branch Head of Operations, you will lead a team, drive measurable improvements in efficiency and straight\-through processing, and partner closely with the front office and key control functions to deliver stable, well\-controlled operations.

 **Job responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end post\-trade delivery, including trade capture and validation, confirmations, settlements, reconciliations, break management, investigations, and issue resolution.
* Own service performance outcomes, improving accuracy, timeliness, straight\-through processing, and client experience.
* Strengthen the risk and control environment through disciplined control execution, issue management, remediation, and audit readiness.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies, maintaining strong governance, documentation, and operating discipline.
* Lead, coach, and develop the team, ensuring clear accountability, effective coverage, and operational resiliency.
* Partner with sales and trading, technology, risk, compliance, and finance teams to resolve exceptions and deliver change effectively.
* Drive automation and process improvements, including workflow redesign, data quality enhancements, and operational dashboards.
* Provide clear reporting on key performance indicators, incidents, control issues, and change delivery progress.

 **Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Bachelor's degree
* Minimum 15 years of experience in markets operations, post\-trade, middle office, or trade support, with end\-to\-end lifecycle ownership across at least one of: foreign exchange, rates derivatives, options, fixed income, or money markets.
* Proven people leadership experience, including coaching, performance management, and building a strong controls culture.
* Strong knowledge of post\-trade processes, including confirmations, settlements, reconciliations, and investigations.
* Track record of delivering measurable improvements, such as reduced breaks, faster turnaround times, higher straight\-through processing, or automation benefits.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence across functions and seniority levels.

Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to use data and key performance indicators to manage performance and prioritize risk.  
* 

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience working in a regulated markets environment, with familiarity with India and emerging markets operating considerations.
* Experience leading change or transformation initiatives in operations in partnership with technology teams.
* Experience leading teams through the adoption of AI\-enabled analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to improve operational efficiency and accuracy, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, well\-controlled execution through coaching, change adoption, and continuous improvement

**ABOUT US**
  

  

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first\-class business in a first\-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long\-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  

  

J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Operations Manager**

\*\*Company:\*\* Rupeexo

\*\*Job Location:\*\* Ahmedabad, Gujarat

\*\*Job Type:\*\* Full\-time, On\-site

\*\*Experience Required:\*\* 5\+ Years

\*\*Department:\*\* Operations

**Job Summary**

Rupeexo is looking for an experienced and result\-oriented \*\*Operations Manager\*\* to oversee and manage day\-to\-day operational activities. The ideal candidate should have strong leadership, process management, problem\-solving, and team\-handling skills, along with an understanding of financial services operations.

\#\#\# Key Responsibilities

1\. Operations Management

\* Oversee daily operations related to loan processing, customer service, collections, field visits, and account management.

\* Develop and implement efficient operational policies and procedures.

\* Monitor operational performance and ensure processes are completed efficiently and on time.

\* Ensure operational activities are aligned with organizational goals and customer expectations.

\* Identify operational challenges and take timely corrective actions.

2\. Team Leadership \& Management

\* manage, and guide the operations team to achieve business objectives.

\* Provide training, direction, and ongoing support to team members.

\* Set team targets and monitor individual and team performance.

\* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.

\* Promote teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement within the team.

3\. Process Improvement

\* Identify gaps and inefficiencies in existing operational processes.

\* Implement data\-driven improvements to enhance productivity and operational efficiency.

\* Monitor key operational metrics and performance indicators.

\* Work closely with cross\-functional teams to improve workflows and service delivery.

\* Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) wherever required.

4\. Compliance \& Risk Management

\* Ensure all operational activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, company policies, and industry standards.

\* Identify and manage operational risks.

\* Implement appropriate processes and controls to minimize operational risks.

\* Stay updated with relevant regulatory and compliance requirements.

\* Ensure the operations team follows established policies and procedures.

5\. Customer Experience

\* Maintain high standards of customer service across all operational touchpoints.

\* Monitor and address customer complaints and service\-related issues.

\* Ensure timely resolution of customer concerns.

\* Work with the customer service and collections teams to improve customer experience.

\* Identify recurring customer issues and recommend process improvements.

Qualifications \& Requirements

\* Bachelor's degree in \*\*Business Administration, Operations Management, Finance, or a related field\*\*.

\* Master's degree will be an added advantage.

\* Minimum \*\*5 years of experience in operations management\*\*, preferably in financial services, NBFC, lending, or related industries.

\* At least \*\*2 years of experience in a team leadership or managerial role\*\*.

\* Strong understanding of operational processes, compliance, and risk management.

\* Excellent leadership and team management skills.

\* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.

\* Good communication and interpersonal skills.

\* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a target\-driven environment.

\* Strong analytical and process\-improvement skills.

Key Skills

Operations Management \| Team Management \| Loan Operations \| Collections \| Customer Service \| Process Improvement \| Risk Management \| Compliance \| Performance Management \| Problem Solving \| Leadership\*\*

What Rupeexo Offers

\* Competitive salary package.

\* Professional and growth\-oriented work environment.

\* Leadership and career development opportunities.

\* Exposure to financial services and lending operations.

\* Opportunity to work with a growing organization.

Work Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Employment Type:Full\-time \| On\-site
